market_outlook.short_term: Highly volatile and bearish. Oil above $100 and bond yields near 5% create a stagflationary pressure. Dow 3-day slide likely continues unless Iran de-escalates. Rate-hike expectations will pressure equities, especially growth. Expect 5-10% equity drawdown risk in next 2-3 weeks. Yen volatility elevated. Gold counterintuitively weak on rate expectations.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook stabilizes if Iran conflict resolves and oil normalizes to $80-90. AI capex cycle (Meta, Google, Microsoft) provides structural equity support. China battery halt signals 12-18 month industrial correction. BOJ tightening continues but yen stabilizes. Inflation moderates by Q1 2027 if oil normalizes. Tech product cycles (Apple foldable) drive consumer spending recovery.
